reading: GVTC is a member-owned telecommunications cooperative headquartered in New Braunfels, Texas, founded in 1951 as the first provider to bring phone service to the Texas Hill Country region north of San Antonio. The cooperative has expanded its service offerings over the decades, adding cable television in the 1980s, high-speed internet in the 1990s, and fiber internet in the 2000s, and today serves communities including Boerne, Bulverde, New Braunfels, Canyon Lake, and Spring Branch with fiber internet, streaming TV, phone, smart security, and mobile services. As a cooperative rather than a shareholder-owned corporation, GVTC operates a Member Dividend Program that has reduced active members' monthly payments by 20 percent since 2018, and the company has been recognized as a top workplace by the San Antonio Express-News for more than a decade along with a number one ranking in Netflix's ISP Speed Index in 2020. GVTC's public materials focus on consumer and small business services rather than wholesale or enterprise data center infrastructure, and no facility-level data center specifications, capacity, or exact location were published as of the research date, so this registry's Texas facility record for GVTC is presumed to be network or central office infrastructure supporting the cooperative's regional telecom service rather than a commercial colocation offering.
